phrases.text: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
Researchers successfully negotiated peace with aliens through diplomacy.
A catastrophic equipment failure destroyed half the laboratory.
Alien forces launched a nighttime assault on the research facility.
A key researcher betrayed the team to join the alien natives.
Soldiers mutinied and destroyed the lab's communication systems.
A prototype spaceship accidentally activated alien relics.
researchers shaking hands with aliens in a lab
smoke rising from broken laboratory equipment
aliens attacking a facility at night
